Linux

Ubuntu 22.04 / compatible glibc · x64

Download for LinuxPortable ZIP · x64 · 44.0 MB

A portable command-line package for a compatible Linux system. No graphical desktop or local full node is required.

Direct downloads from the project's official GitHub release. Portable ZIPs only: no installer and no pre-filled configuration file. Windows binaries are unsigned; macOS binaries are ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Latest stable release checked on October 18, 2026.

Checksums & release details (opens in a new tab)

From download to your first run.

01 / Extract

Unzip the complete package into a writable folder. Keep the executable, libraries, and helpers together.

02 / Configure

The first run creates claimer.conf if it is missing. Set your receiving address and connection limits before starting claims.

03 / Run

Launch the client again from your terminal. It uses the configuration file and shows its activity while claiming.

Prefer a graphical interface? Automatic Claims is also available in Connect Wallet and ConnectCoin Core.
